subtitle.tx: Fikrni himoya qilish, rad etish, kelishuv

body.en: For something that did not happen or is only imagined, Uzbek adds edi to the condition: -sa edi or -ganda edi in the 'if' part, and -ar edi in the result, usually fused into one word (kelar edim → kelardim). Bilganimda edi, aytgan bo'lardim = If I had known, I would have said it. Vaqtim bo'lsa edi, kelardim = If I had time, I would come. Agar ('if') can open the sentence, but it is often left out.

examples: If I had known, I would have told you.
If I had time, I would come.

body.en: Useful phrases for disagreeing without giving offense: Gapingizda jon bor, lekin… (there's some truth in what you say, but…; literally 'there is life in your words'), Aksincha (on the contrary), Buni boshqacha ko'raman (I see it differently). In a formal debate, keep to siz and its endings (-ingiz, -ing).

examples: There's some truth in what you say, but… (formal)

body.en: To structure an argument: bir tomondan… ikkinchi tomondan (on the one hand… on the other hand), shuni ta'kidlash joizki (it should be stressed that), boshqacha aytganda (in other words), xulosa o'rnida (in conclusion), shunga qaramay (nevertheless).

examples: on the one hand… on the other hand

phrases: My thesis is based on three arguments.
I want to highlight an overlooked aspect.
This is a completely unfounded claim.
Based on the most recent research…
This seems like a plausible hypothesis to me.
Bu menga ishonarli faraz bo'lib tuyuladi.
drills: To defend your thesis, you need stronger arguments.
Tezisingni himoya qilish uchun senga kuchliroq dalillar kerak.
If the premise is wrong, the conclusion will be wrong too.
Agar muqaddima noto'g'ri bo'lsa, xulosa ham noto'g'ri bo'ladi.
The professor proved his thesis with very precise data.
Professor o'z tezisini juda aniq ma'lumotlar bilan isbotlab berdi.
We can't assume that everyone will agree with us.
Hamma biz bilan rozi bo'ladi, deb taxmin qilib bo'lmaydi.
His criticisms were unfounded, and in the end he admitted it himself.
Uning tanqidlari asossiz edi va oxir-oqibat buni o'zi ham tan oldi.
Based on last year's data, I think your conclusion is well-founded. (formal)
O'tgan yilgi ma'lumotlarga asoslanib, xulosangiz asosli deb o'ylayman.
Which of these two explanations seems more plausible to you?
Bu ikki tushuntirishdan qaysi biri senga ishonarliroq tuyuladi?
I'd like to point out that so far no one has proven the opposite.
Shuni ta'kidlamoqchimanki, hozircha hech kim buning aksini isbotlamagan.
If I had had more time, I would have proven my thesis more clearly.
Ko'proq vaqtim bo'lganida edi, tezisimni aniqroq isbotlab bergan bo'lardim.
Let's assume for a moment that you all are right.
Keling, bir daqiqaga siz haqsiz, deb taxmin qilaylik.
This hypothesis is plausible, but it still has to be proven.
Bu faraz ishonarli, lekin uni hali isbotlash kerak.
The journalist pointed out a problem that no one had noticed.
Jurnalist hech kim e'tibor bermagan muammoni ta'kidlab o'tdi.

phrases: Allow me to raise an objection. (formal)
There's a contradiction in your reasoning. (formal)
This is, at the very least, a debatable issue.
drills: Do you have any objections to this proposal before we vote? (formal)
Ovoz berishdan oldin bu taklif bo'yicha biror e'tirozingiz bormi?
The company denied the news a few hours later.
Kompaniya bu xabarni bir necha soat o'tib rad etdi.
Maybe I didn't explain myself well and you misunderstood me.
Balki men fikrimni yaxshi tushuntirmadim va sen meni noto'g'ri tushunding.
Please don't generalize, because every case is different from the others.
Iltimos, umumlashtirma, chunki har bir holat boshqalaridan farq qiladi.
In his speech there was a contradiction between his first and last sentences.
Uning nutqida birinchi va oxirgi gaplari o'rtasida ziddiyat bor edi.
It's not an easy topic: it has many subtleties that are often overlooked.
Bu oson mavzu emas, uning ko'plab nozik jihatlari ko'pincha e'tiborsiz qoladi.
Every rule has exceptions, but this case isn't one of them.
Har qanday qoidaning istisnolari bor, lekin bu holat ulardan biri emas.
Your proposal is debatable, but it's worth listening to.
Sening taklifing bahsli, lekin uni tinglab ko'rishga arziydi.
I thought the project was expensive; on the contrary, it turns out to be very cheap.
Loyiha qimmat deb o'ylagandim, aksincha, u juda arzon ekan.
His objections were weak; nevertheless, we discussed them carefully.
Uning e'tirozlari zaif edi, shunga qaramay, biz ularni diqqat bilan muhokama qildik.
If you had listened to me until the end, you wouldn't have misunderstood me.
Agar meni oxirigacha tinglaganingda edi, meni noto'g'ri tushunmagan bo'larding.
Experts have rejected the idea that coffee is always harmful.
Mutaxassislar qahva har doim zararli degan fikrni rad etishdi.

phrases: We are open to a counteroffer.
We can't concede on this issue.
Let's look for a mutually beneficial solution.
Let's put the agreement in writing.
drills: The negotiations lasted three days, but in the end we signed the contract.
Muzokaralar uch kun davom etdi, lekin oxir-oqibat shartnomani imzoladik.
What are your conditions for signing the contract this week? (plural)
Shartnomani shu hafta imzolash uchun sizning shartlaringiz qanday?
If we give in now, next time they'll demand even more.
Agar hozir yon bersak, keyingi safar ular bundan ham ko'proq talab qilishadi.
The director stood firm on the price and didn't change his mind.
Direktor narx masalasida qat'iy turib oldi va fikrini o'zgartirmadi.
Yesterday we received a very interesting offer from a foreign company.
Kecha bir xorijiy kompaniyadan juda qiziqarli taklif oldik.
We'll send you our counteroffer by email by Friday. (plural)
Qarshi taklifimizni juma kunigacha elektron xat orqali sizga yuboramiz.
We have serious budget constraints that can't be ignored.
Bizda e'tiborsiz qoldirib bo'lmaydigan jiddiy byudjet cheklovlari bor.
We have no more room to give in: this is our final price.
Endi yon berishga imkon qolmadi, bu bizning yakuniy narximiz.
Mutual trust is the most important foundation of any successful negotiation.
O'zaro ishonch har qanday muvaffaqiyatli muzokaraning eng muhim asosidir.
We would accept your offer if you shortened the delivery time. (plural)
Agar yetkazib berish muddatini qisqartirsangiz, taklifingizni qabul qilardik.
They insisted so much that in the end we gave in.
Ular shunchalik qat'iy turishdiki, oxiri biz yon berdik.
Did you read all the terms of the agreement carefully before signing it?
Imzolashdan oldin kelishuvning barcha shartlarini diqqat bilan o'qib chiqdingmi?

phrases: I try to stay as objective as possible.
Iloji boricha xolis qolishga harakat qilaman.
I don't want to distort the data.
She only emphasized the positive aspects.
U faqat ijobiy jihatlarga urg'u berdi.
One effective argument is better than ten weak ones.
Bitta samarali dalil o'nta zaifidan afzal.
drills: I finally managed to persuade my father to buy an electric car.
Nihoyat otamni elektr mashina sotib olishga ko'ndira oldim.
His oratory is truly brilliant, but his arguments are rather weak.
Uning notiqligi haqiqatan ajoyib, lekin dalillari ancha zaif.
It's very hard for a company that has lost its credibility once to regain it.
Ishonchliligini bir marta yo'qotgan kompaniya uni qayta tiklashi juda qiyin.
In the summer, the mayor appealed to all citizens to save water.
Yozda hokim suvni tejash bo'yicha barcha fuqarolarga murojaat qildi.
Why did you emphasize only the risks and not the advantages?
Nega faqat xavflarga urg'u berding, afzalliklarga esa yo'q?
Don't downplay the problem: it's actually more serious than you think.
Muammoni kichraytirma, u aslida sen o'ylagandan ham jiddiyroq.
Unfortunately, some ads try to manipulate children's emotions.
Afsuski, ba'zi reklamalar bolalarning tuyg'ularini manipulyatsiya qilishga urinadi.

Yaxshi jurnalist hatto rozi bo'lmaganda ham xolis bo'lishi kerak.
Your presentation was clear, but not convincing enough.
Taqdimoting aniq edi, lekin yetarlicha ishontiruvchi emas edi.
In your opinion, what is the most effective way to convince new customers? (formal)
Sizningcha, yangi mijozlarni ishontirishning eng samarali usuli qanday?
If you had used concrete examples, your speech would have been more convincing.
Aniq misollardan foydalanganingda edi, nutqing ishontiruvchiroq bo'lgan bo'lardi.
No one will be able to persuade me that this is a good idea.
Hech kim meni bu yaxshi fikr ekanligiga ko'ndira olmaydi.

phrases: He used a very effective metaphor.
drills: Our professor's eloquence amazes all the students every time.
Professorimizning notiqligi har safar barcha talabalarni hayratga soladi.
A good speaker knows when to stop and make an effective pause.
Yaxshi notiq qachon to'xtab, ta'sirli pauza qilishni biladi.
He doesn't have much experience, but he has natural charisma.
Uning tajribasi ko'p emas, lekin tabiiy jozibadorligi bor.

Agar har bir so'zga urg'u bersang, hech biri ajralib turmaydi.

Ritorik savol berganda, notiq aslida tinglovchilardan javob kutmaydi.
The analogy between the brain and a computer helps you understand the topic.
Miya va kompyuter o'rtasidagi o'xshatish mavzuni tushunishga yordam beradi.
When he says he read a thousand books in a year, it's obviously an exaggeration.
U bir yilda ming kitob o'qidim desa, bu, albatta, bo'rttirish.
He spoke in a persuasive tone, never breaking eye contact with the audience for a moment.
U ishontiruvchi ohangda gapirdi, tinglovchilar bilan ko'z bilan aloqani bir lahza ham uzmadi.

U nutqini bolaligi haqidagi kulgili hikoyacha bilan boshladi.
The audience remembers the opening and the closing best.

Asosiy yo'nalish bo'lmagani uchun nutq tarqoq fikrlar ro'yxatiga o'xshardi.

Nutq ta'siri faqat so'zlarga emas, tana tiliga ham bog'liq.

phrases: Let's begin with a clear starting hypothesis.
drills: Your article is interesting, but it lacks a clear central idea.
Maqolang qiziqarli, lekin unda aniq markaziy fikr yetishmaydi.
If the initial assumption is false, the whole line of reasoning collapses.
Agar dastlabki qabul qilingan fikr noto'g'ri bo'lsa, butun mulohaza barbod bo'ladi.
Deduction goes from the general to the particular; induction does the opposite.
Deduksiya umumiydan xususiyga boradi, induksiya esa buning aksini qiladi.
Unfortunately, no reliable conclusion can be drawn from so little data.
Afsuski, bunday kam ma'lumotlardan ishonchli xulosa chiqarib bo'lmaydi.
This study was conducted with great scientific rigor from beginning to end.
Bu tadqiqot boshidan oxirigacha katta ilmiy qat'iylik bilan o'tkazildi.
These numbers are only approximate: don't consider them exact. (plural)
Bu raqamlar shunchaki taxminiy, ularni aniq deb hisoblamang.
Before answering your question, I'd like to make a small clarification. (formal)
Savolingizga javob berishdan oldin, kichik bir aniqlashtirish kiritmoqchiman.

Tajribali notiq tinglovchilarning ehtimoliy e'tirozlariga oldindan javob beradi.

Sizningcha, munozarada raqiblarimiz qanday qarshi dalil keltirishi mumkin?
This digression is interesting, but let's get back to the main issue.
Mavzudan bu chekinish qiziq, lekin keling, asosiy masalaga qaytaylik.

Hisobot oxirida asosiy fikrlarni jamlagan bir sahifalik yakuniy xulosa bor.

Muhim ko'rsatkichlarni keltirmasang, xulosang hech kimga ishonarli bo'lmaydi.

phrases: He found a flaw in the reasoning.
drills: With new data, the researcher showed that his colleague's conclusions were unfounded.
Tadqiqotchi yangi ma'lumotlar bilan hamkasbining xulosalari asossizligini ko'rsatdi.

Kompaniya o'n kun ichida sud qaroriga qarshi rasmiy e'tiroz bildirdi.
At that time no one questioned the director's words.
O'sha paytda hech kim direktorning so'zlarini shubha ostiga olmas edi.

Tanlangan namuna vakillik qilmaydi, shuning uchun natijalarni nisbiylashtirish lozim.

Maqola o'qiyotganda faktni shaxsiy fikrdan farqlash juda muhim.
If it's not clear, I can rephrase the question more simply.
Agar tushunarsiz bo'lsa, savolni soddaroq qilib boshqacha ifodalay olaman.
If you look carefully, there's an obvious logical error in his reasoning. (plural)
Agar diqqat bilan qarasangiz, uning mulohazasida aniq mantiqiy xato bor.
The evidence presented is insufficient for such a strong conclusion.
Taqdim etilgan dalillar bunday qat'iy xulosa uchun yetarsiz.
The article relies on a dubious source, so I don't trust it.
Maqola shubhali manbaga tayanadi, shuning uchun unga ishonmayman.
The company itself paid for the study, so there's a conflict of interest here.
Tadqiqot uchun kompaniyaning o'zi pul to'lagan, demak, bu yerda manfaatlar to'qnashuvi bor.
In my opinion, it's not a causal relationship, just a simple coincidence.
Menimcha, bu sababiy bog'liqlik emas, shunchaki oddiy tasodif.
He received the research results with healthy skepticism.
U tadqiqotning natijalarini sog'lom shubhachilik bilan qabul qildi.

phrases: On this issue there is a red line.
We have reached a preliminary agreement.
drills: After two weeks of tough negotiations, the parties signed the contract.
Ikki haftalik keskin muzokaradan so'ng tomonlar shartnomani imzoladi.
The stakes are so high that we can't afford to make mistakes.
Xavf ostidagi manfaatlar shunchalik kattaki, xato qilishga haqqimiz yo'q.

Yangi qonun tufayli bizning harakat erkinligimiz juda cheklangan.

Biz uchun o'zaro tenglik muhim, har bir yon berish evaziga nimadir olinishi kerak.

Thanks to this clause, we can withdraw from the agreement at any time.
Bu shartnoma bandi tufayli istalgan paytda kelishuvdan chiqishimiz mumkin.

Muzokaralar bir necha oydan beri boshi berk ko'chaga kirib qolgan.

Faqat mustaqil vositachi vaziyatni muzdan chiqara olishi mumkin.
All the signatories must respect the agreement in good faith.
Barcha imzolovchi tomonlar kelishuvga vijdonan rioya qilishi shart.

Biz har qanday yo'l bilan yutishni istamaymiz, ikki tomon uchun foydali yechim izlaymiz.

phrases: Regarding your request, I inform you of the following. (formal)

drills: We hereby inform you that the meeting has been postponed.
Mazkur xat orqali yig'ilish keyinga qoldirilganini ma'lum qilamiz.

Imzolangan shartnoma va hisob-fakturani sizga ilova tarzida yubormoqdamiz.
Under the contract, payment must be made within thirty days.
Shartnomaga muvofiq, to'lov o'ttiz kun ichida amalga oshirilishi kerak.

Ma'lum qilinadiki, ofis ta'mirlash ishlari sababli dushanbagacha yopiq bo'ladi.
All guests are asked to arrive ten minutes before the event begins.
Barcha mehmonlardan tadbir boshlanishidan o'n daqiqa oldin kelish so'ralmoqda.
The payment was not received; therefore, the contract has been canceled.
To'lov kelib tushmadi, shu sababli shartnoma bekor qilindi.

Boshqacha ko'rsatilmagan bo'lsa, barcha darslar soat to'qqizda boshlanadi.
As for payment, do you prefer a bank transfer or paying by card? (formal)
To'lovga kelsak, pul o'tkazmasini afzal ko'rasizmi yoki karta orqali to'lashni?

Misol tariqasida Samarqanddagi bir kichik kompaniya holatini keltiramiz.
The aforementioned rule received final approval last week.
Yuqorida qayd etilgan qoida o'tgan hafta yakuniy tarzda tasdiqlandi.
All employees must attend the meeting, except in cases of illness.
Barcha xodimlar yig'ilishda qatnashishi shart, kasallik holatlari bundan mustasno.

phrases: O'z fikrini tasdiqlash moyiligidan ehtiyot bo'ling.

vocab: to bring back to the topic
phrases: Let's point out the common ground.
drills: After three hours of discussion, we found a compromise that everyone could accept.

body.en: Uzbek makes abstract nouns by adding -lik to nouns and adjectives, much like English -ness, -ship or -ity: do'st → do'stlik (friendship), boy → boylik (wealth), ishsiz → ishsizlik (unemployment). Before a vowel it becomes -lig-: boyligi (his wealth). -chilik names an activity or a field: dehqon (farmer) → dehqonchilik (farming, agriculture).

Economic news likes short past-tense statements and the passive: narxlar oshdi (prices went up), o'sish qayd etildi (growth was recorded). The passive is made with -il- or -l- (qayd et- → qayd etildi), and, as in English 'it was reported', nobody needs to be named as the doer.

body.en: Scientific Uzbek relies on the passive and on impersonal forms: aniqlandi (it was established), ko'rsatildi (it was shown), isbotlandi (it was proven), deb hisoblanadi (it is believed). Because the verb comes last, the content goes first: where English says 'It has been proven that…', Uzbek says '…isbotlandi.'

To hedge a statement: ehtimol (probably), -sa kerak (must be, I suppose), taxminan (approximately), bo'lishi mumkin (it may be). Shunday bo'lsa kerak = That's probably so; Shunday bo'lishi mumkin = That may be so.

body.en: Uzbek has no words like 'which', 'who' or 'where' to join clauses. The describing clause goes before the noun and its verb becomes a participle: -gan for finished actions (men senga aytgan kitob = the book I told you about) and -digan for present or habitual ones (men yashaydigan uy = the house where I live). For 'whose', the possessive ending goes on the thing owned: muallifi mashhur bo'lgan kitob = the book whose author is famous.

examples: the book I told you about

body.en: To comment on a work: menda kuchli taassurot qoldirdi (it made a strong impression on me), meni befarq qoldirmadi (it didn't leave me indifferent), meni to'liq ishontirmadi (it didn't fully convince me). The work is the subject, and the person goes in the locative (menda) or the accusative (meni).

examples: It made a strong impression on me.

body.en: To report what someone said, Uzbek turns the reported verb into a noun with -gan (past) or -ish (future or intention), adds a possessive ending and the accusative -ni, and ends with aytdi (said): U kelishini aytdi = He said he would come; U tugatganini aytdi = He said he had finished. Unlike English, the tense does not shift back. You can also quote directly with deb: «Kelaman», deb aytdi.

To talk about people and facts in general: odamlar (people), ko'pchilik (most people), aytishlaricha (they say, reportedly), ma'lumotlarga ko'ra (according to the data). The postposition …ga ko'ra works like 'according to'.

body.en: In casual speech Uzbek shortens verb forms (nima qilyapsan → nima qivossan) and adds particles such as -ku, -da and -chi for tone. Formal writing keeps full forms and prefers the passive. Sen and siz mark register too: Nima qilyapsan? to a friend, Nima istaysiz? to a customer.

Idioms can't be translated word for word. Some happen to match English: og'zi qulog'ida (literally 'his mouth is at his ear') is 'grinning from ear to ear'. Others don't: qo'lidan ish keladi (literally 'work comes from his hand') means 'he's capable'. Learn them as whole phrases.

examples: He's grinning from ear to ear.

body.en: Many ideas that English expresses with a phrasal verb or a fixed phrase have their own Uzbek set phrases, best learned whole: uddasidan chiqmoq (to manage, to cope), ketib qolmoq (to go off, to leave), vaqt kerak (it takes time). Note Men ketdim (literally 'I left'), said to mean 'I'm off' as you are leaving.

To give advice gently: …ganing ma'qul (you'd better…), …ib ko'rsang-chi? (why don't you try…?), …ishing kerak (you should). With siz they become …ganingiz ma'qul and …ishingiz kerak. 'If I were you' is Sening o'rningda bo'lsam, literally 'if I were in your place'.

subtitle.en: Academic applications, presentations, life as an immigrant

body.en: Uzbek academic writing is full of passives and verbal nouns: tahlil qilindi (was analyzed), o'rganish maqsad qilingan (the aim is to study). Set phrases frame the argument: Ushbu ish …ni maqsad qilgan (This paper aims to…), Bundan kelib chiqadiki… (It follows that…).
A useful structure: Avvalo… (first of all), Keyingi qismda… (in the next part), Xulosa qilib aytganda… (to sum up), Savollaringiz bo'lsa… (if you have any questions). Address the audience with siz.
